sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Strict type-checking settings
sections.what: Sets the compiler target, the libraries available, how modules are found, and a long list of strict checks. Limits checking to the src and scripts folders.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: strict settings catch errors before a reader sees a wrong figure.
sections.watch_out: Some strict checks reject code that looks right, so one flag can block an otherwise working change.

summary: Sets strict TypeScript checking for the frontend source and scripts, and tells the compiler to write no output files.
purpose: Makes the type checker catch common mistakes in the viewer code before it runs.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: strict checks catch problems early, which matters in a viewer that shows figures a reader may quote.
how: The checker reads the src and scripts folders, targets a modern JavaScript version, turns on strict mode, extra checks for unused code, index reads that may be missing, and optional fields, and then emits no files.
inputs: Source files in the src and scripts folders.
outputs: Type errors when they exist. No output files, because output is turned off.
risks: Some strict flags reject code that looks correct, so a single flag can block a change. Skipping library checks means type errors inside libraries are not reported.
debug: Read the first error. The flag name often appears in the message. Run the type check command alone to see the errors without the rest of the build.
